what: The Unit Converter changes a value from one unit to another in eight categories: Length, Weight, Temperature, Area, Volume, Speed, Data and Time. Pick a category, type a value, choose the "From" and "To" units, and the answer appears at once.

It is useful for cooking, travel, school work, building projects, shopping online from other countries and reading technical specs. You can swap the units with one click and copy the result to paste somewhere else.
All conversions run in your browser.
uses: Change miles to kilometers or mph to km/h.
Convert US cups, fluid ounces and milliliters for recipes.
Turn Fahrenheit into Celsius or the other way.
Convert acres, hectares and square feet.
See how many megabytes are in a gigabyte.
Convert kilograms to pounds or stone.
tutorial: Open "Category" and pick Length, Weight, Temperature, Area, Volume, Speed, Data or Time. The unit lists refill for that category.
Enter a number in "Value". It starts at 1. Decimals and negative numbers are allowed.
Choose the starting unit in "From" and the target unit in "To". After you change category, "To" is set to the second unit in the list.
The result line shows the full sentence, for example "5 Mile = 8.04672 Kilometer".
Click "Swap units" to reverse the conversion. Click "Copy result" to copy only the converted number to your clipboard.
features: Length, Weight, Temperature, Area, Volume, Speed, Data and Time.
Each unit is stored as a number of base units (for example 1 Mile = 1609.344 meters). The tool multiplies your value by the From factor and divides by the To factor.
Celsius to Fahrenheit is C × 9 ÷ 5 + 32, and Kelvin is C + 273.15. Other directions use the reverse.
Includes US gallon, quart, cup and fluid ounce, plus UK gallon.
Data units use 1024 steps: 1 Kilobyte = 1024 bytes, and 1 Bit = 1/8 byte.
Results are rounded to 10 significant digits to remove tiny computer rounding errors.
Reverse units in one click and copy the number for use elsewhere.

example.title: Worked example: distance, temperature and data
example.text: Choose Length, type 5, set From to Mile and To to Kilometer. The result is "5 Mile = 8.04672 Kilometer", because 5 × 1609.344 ÷ 1000 = 8.04672. Switch to Temperature, type 100 and convert Fahrenheit to Celsius: (100 − 32) × 5 ÷ 9 = 37.77777778. In Data, 1 Gigabyte to Megabyte gives 1024. Click "Swap units" and the conversion runs the other way.

tips: After changing category, check the From and To units again, because the lists are reset.
"Copy result" copies only the number, without the unit name.
Year in the Time category means 365 days, so it ignores leap years.
Phone and disk makers often use 1000-based sizes, so their numbers can look larger than this tool’s 1024-based results.
Use US cup for American recipes; other countries may use a different cup size.
